purpose: Introduce the parallel 12345->13524 permutation family, preserve its provenance independently from 12345->31542, and ingest the first authoritative physical-value hits surfaced by scanning its newly generated states.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, authoritative dataset, advisory, or information item discovered during the inquiry receives a Worldshepherd use or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Duplicate mirrors, derivative copies, repeated records, and complementary views of the same authority are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Search co-occurrence, identifiers, page numbers and other numeric collisions are not Glob evidence unless an independently verified physical quantity in the declared unit family is established.

sources.title: Analysis of the Spectrum of Doubly Ionized Molybdenum (Mo III)
sources.authors: L. Iglesias; M. I. Cabeza; V. Kaufman
sources.authority: Journal of Research of the National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.note: Use as a primary experimental/analysis source for Mo III level and transition topology. The paper reports the 4d3(2D2)5p 1P1 level at 93709.46 cm^-1 and classifies multiple observed lines involving that level.

sources.title: NIST Atomic Spectra Database — Pb III energy levels
sources.authority: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.note: Current ASD lists the Pb III 5d10 6s6p 3P0 level at exactly 60397 cm^-1. NIST notes uncertainty in classifications for some highly mixed configurations and states that these levels need further confirmation; retain that caution with the physical-value hit.

permutation_update.claims_boundary: This family supplements rather than replaces 12345->31542. All generated states retain permutation-family provenance and add to the experiment-wide search multiplicity.

exact_9675_policy.rule: 09675 and its orbit are derived five-position data and must never replace or be silently conflated with exact seed 9675.

evidence_updates.claims_boundary: The value is within the existing 1 cm^-1 screening tolerance and participates in multiple classified Mo III lines. This is a physical-value hit only; it does not establish causal significance of the 13524 permutation and must enter global null/multiple-testing correction.

Exact numerical equality occurs in current NIST ASD, but NIST's own Pb III notes require retaining level/classification caution. Count as a current-authority physical-value hit, not as independent proof of the permutation.

information_updates.finding: Adding 12345->13524 introduces 78 unique target states not present in the original 12345->31542 state reservoir, while 35 states overlap. Statistical correction must therefore operate on the union of predeclared targets and retain family membership rather than treating the new family as a free exploratory follow-up.
information_updates.claims_boundary: The larger state reservoir increases the expected number of accidental matches. Any apparent gain in hit count must be compared against the correspondingly larger null search space.

information_updates.finding: Under 12345->13524 the core 99073 orbit is 99073 -> 90397 -> 93709 -> 97930 -> 99073. The 93709 state immediately intersects a documented Mo III energy level at 93709.46 cm^-1.
information_updates.claims_boundary: 90397 and 97930 remain unpromoted unless authoritative physical-value evidence is independently verified.

information_updates.finding: The 8679305 window 67930 produces 67930 -> 69073 -> 60397 -> 63709 under 12345->13524; current NIST Pb III contains an exact 60397 cm^-1 level.
information_updates.claims_boundary: The hit is in a different atomic system from the Mo III 93709 hit. It is P1, not P2; no cross-species relational claim is made.

next_actions: Continue same-unit physical-value scans across all 78 states newly introduced by 12345->13524, prioritizing authoritative NIST/primary spectroscopy sources over identifiers and search mirrors.
Acquire full Mo III and Pb III transition data around 93709.46 and 60397 cm^-1 and test for same-species topology/relational motifs involving any other predeclared states.
Acquire complete N I and W II machine-readable line graphs and retain permutation-family labels in all topology/relational analyses.

Update global null and false-discovery calculations to use the union of both permutation families, deduplicating the 35 overlapping states and preserving the 78 newly added states as additional tests.
